ratchetRule: ICTC 1.1 keeps one server semantic authority. Oggi, Processi and Evidenze are presentation projections over the same runtime state. The seven business processes remain standalone peers in presentation while preserving process-specific lifecycle and scope semantics. Procedure enablement is server-authoritative and may suppress new operational work without deleting historical decisions or evidence. Browser surfaces may not create semantic authority locally.
limitations: 1.1 stable · Enterprise Candidate is a bounded product profile, not legal compliance, certification or universal production readiness.
The seven business processes remain directly openable when enabled; deterministic routing is assistance and always requires human selection.
A disabled procedure is removed from new operational routing/work and writes while historical records and evidence remain readable.
AI OFF preserves business-process manual paths; AI ON adds proposals only and cannot become organizational decision authority.
Coverage is bounded to the declared universe and heatmap values require human-reviewed risk ratings, preferring residual assessment when available.
Execution of remediation and verified closure are distinct checkpoints; closure requires human verification and EvidenceRef.
Evidenze presents recorded decisions, provenance and integrity; this does not establish substantive sufficiency or compliance.
Deployment readiness remains bounded by explicit external controls and attestations, and independent human comprehension remains not-assessed without E4 evidence.
